description:
Set right on the beach, Weligama Bay Marriott Resort & Spa offers beach front rooms, a year-round children's pool, relaxation pool and outdoor lap pool. It also offers water sport facilities and has close proximity to the Galle Fort and Blue Whale watching hubs. The resort also offers a garden with outdoor furniture, a mini-bar, bathtubs and ironing facilities.

Guests can access the property through the Southern Expressway with 2 hour drive from Colombo. Bandaranaike International Airport is 109 mi from the property. The drive takes 2.5 hours and is scenic through the Southern Express Highway.

Offering unrestricted views of the Indian Ocean from all rooms, bath tub and balcony, every room is fitted with a 55-inch LED smart TV featuring satellite channels. Rooms are fitted with a day bed. All rooms come with a private bathroom, where you will find a bathtub, bathrobes, slippers and free toiletries. Suites will feature a dining area.

Guests can either enjoy a meal at the various F&B outlets at the property, or opt to have a barbecue at the terrace. Weligama Bay Marriott Resort & Spa also offers business centers and free WiFi throughout the property. Free private parking is also available on site. You will even find a 24-hour front desk at the property with express check-in and check-out facilities. Concierge services will also be provided on request.

Guests can also choose to take some time out to rejuvenate their senses at Quan Spa. Choose from a range of wellness therapies and treatments. The spa features five treatment rooms including a couples’ therapy room.

Galle Fort Walk in the Evening (Fort on Foot)

Enjoy a family-friendly guided walking tour around Galle Fort. Your host will share fascinating stories about the past, the people, and the culture of the fort, offering insights into the Dutch colonial period in Sri Lanka. End your tour by watching the sunset near the Galle Fort lighthouse.

Mirissa Coastal Adventure

Start your day with a guided tour of Mirissa's bustling harbor, where you'll learn about the lives of local fishermen and their traditional fishing practices.

Galle Fort & Coastal Treasures: A Local-Led Excursion

Explore the island's cultural and natural wonders with visits to the Koggala turtle sanctuary, stilt fishing sites, Galle Dutch Fort, and Galle National Maritime Museum. Wear light, comfortable clothing and bring a hat, sunglasses, and sweater. Entrance tickets are available at these locations and can be purchased in local currency only.

Sail Away - Whale Watching on a Private Catamaran

Experience a private whale-watching tour aboard your own catamaran, complete with breakfast and a light lunch. The slow-moving catamaran allows you to enjoy the sea and gives you the flexibility to extend your time whale watching. During the waiting time, you can snorkel, swim, and paddleboard. The tour begins at the Mirissa fisheries harbor at 6:30 AM and lasts about 7 hours.

Yala Wildlife Safari

Yala is home to 44 species of mammals and 215 species of birds, including the world’s largest concentration of leopards, majestic elephants, sloth bears, sambars, jackals, spotted deer, peacocks, and crocodiles. The best time to visit is between February and July when the water levels are low, making wildlife more visible.

This safari offers an up-close encounter with the untamed world of wildlife. Whether you are a seasoned nature enthusiast or visiting a wildlife park for the first time, if you come with an open mind eager to explore and learn, you will leave with a new perspective on life.

A Village Ride

This experience starts with a boat ride down the Kapu Ela River, accompanied by a local naturalist knowledgeable about the local birds and reptiles. Relax and enjoy the journey past riverbanks, through canals, and under bridges. After the boat ride, you will cycle through rural Galle, passing paddy fields, local markets, and riverbanks. The standard trail is about 3.7 mi, but you can opt for 5.6 mi or 9.3 mi trails if you prefer a longer ride. The tour concludes at a thatched-roof mud hut on Paddy Island.

South Coast Cinnamon (Visit to a Cinnamon Estate)

Visit a picturesque cinnamon estate where you will see cinnamon nurseries, oil distillation, and the peeling process. You can even try peeling cinnamon yourself. Enjoy different varieties of cinnamon tea and a delicious cinnamon-infused juice.

Southern Blend (Tea Factory Visit)

Tour a private tea estate and a modern tea factory. Walk through some of the most scenic estates in the southern region and learn about the history and cultivation of tea. At the factory, observe the different stages of tea production and sample various types of tea.

Sail Away – Sunset Cruise on a Private Catamaran

Enjoy the sea's beauty as the sun sets and the cool sea breeze surrounds you. Board the catamaran to take in the picturesque scenery with your loved ones. Create lasting memories over a hot cup of Ceylon tea and snacks. This cruise is more than just a travel experience; it’s a lifelong adventure.

Udawalawe Wildlife Safari

Udawalawe is a vital habitat for water birds and Sri Lankan elephants, which are relatively easy to spot in its open spaces. Many elephants are drawn to the park due to the Udawalawe reservoir. The park is also home to the rusty-spotted cat, fishing cat, and Sri Lankan leopard. Although leopard and sloth bear sightings are rare, they are possible.

A Boat Trip on the Madu River

Take an enchanting speedboat ride along the beautiful Madu River, a wetland estuary covering 900 hectares, with 770 hectares of water and 64 islands. This boat ride offers a closer look at this complex wetland ecosystem, a World Heritage site protected by the Ramsar Convention on Wetlands, and one of the last pristine mangrove forests in Sri Lanka.
